about: The episode Lecture opens on a series when Jellyfin's next up says none (Shows/NextUp answers nothing for a series watched to its end, and leaves the specials out): one left halfway, else the first not watched, else the first, to watch it again; the numbered seasons before the specials (season 0), which Jellyfin lists first. Read by tests/Mira.Core.Tests (EpisodePages.Unfinished, Start) and the iPhone (SeriesStart): both must agree. A series watched again: the one after the episode watched last (EpisodePages.Again, SeriesStart.again), unless that one is a special or the last, or shares its date. cases: [name, episodes [id, season (null: none, read as 1), watched, position in % of its length, last played in minutes from any moment (absent or null: never)], unfinished (null: none), start (null: none)]
cases: watched to its end: again from S01E01, not from the special Jellyfin lists first
only a special left to watch: offered
watched out of order: the one skipped, before a special
one left halfway wins over the first not watched
a numbered episode left halfway before a special left halfway
watched again and left halfway (Jellyfin 12 keeps it watched)
stopped past 90 %: not resumed there, the first not watched instead
episodes without a season count as the first
watched again: the one after the episode watched last
watched again past a season's last episode: the next season's first
watched again to its last episode: from S01E01 once more
marked watched at once (Jellyfin dates each in turn, in their order): from S01E01
marked watched with one date: from S01E01
a special watched last: from S01E01
watched again and left halfway: resumed there, whatever was watched after
not all watched: the first not watched, whatever was watched last
